title: ExitLUT: Boolean Early Exits for Efficient FPGA-Based Neural Network Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.31540v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Early exit neural networks reduce average inference cost by terminating once sufficient confidence is reached. On FPGAs, conventional confidence-based exits add arithmetic control paths poorly matched to LUT fabrics, consuming resources that could otherwise support the main datapath. We present ExitLUT, which replaces softmax-style exit decisions with learned Boolean functions mapped directly into FPGA LUTs. In our CNN evaluation, fpgaConvNet is the static spatial-dataflow baseline, while ATHEENA is its softmax-based early exit extension. ExitLUT reduces ATHEENA's exit-decision LUT usage by 2.58$\times$ over the softmax path and eliminates decision-path DSP usage, while preserving accuracy and exit behavior. Rerunning design-space exploration reinvests these savings into the datapath, improving throughput by up to 4.08$\times$ over fpgaConvNet and 1.82$\times$ over ATHEENA. For LUT-based NNs, embedded ExitLUT exits achieve 1.41-1.89$\t

translated_title: ExitLUT：面向高效FPGA神经网络推理的布尔早期退出机制
translated_abstract: 早期退出神经网络通过在达到足够置信度时终止推理来降低平均推理成本。在FPGA上，传统的基于置信度的退出机制会引入与LUT结构不匹配的算术控制路径，消耗了本可用于主数据通路的资源。我们提出ExitLUT，用直接映射到FPGA LUT中的可学习布尔函数来替代softmax风格的退出决策。在CNN评估中，fpgaConvNet是静态空间数据流基线，而ATHEENA是其基于softmax的早期退出扩展。ExitLUT将ATHEENA的退出决策LUT使用量相比softmax路径降低2.58倍，并消除了决策路径的DSP使用，同时保持精度和退出行为不变。重新运行设计空间探索可将这些节省的资源再投入到数据通路中，吞吐量相比fpgaConvNet提升高达4.08倍，相比ATHEENA提升1.82倍。对于基于LUT的神经网络，嵌入式ExitLUT退出实现了1.41–1.89倍的性能提升。
tldr: ExitLUT用直接映射到FPGA LUT的可学习布尔函数替代softmax置信度退出决策，将节省的退出路径资源重新投入主数据通路，在保持精度不变的前提下实现高达4.08倍的吞吐量提升。
en_tdlr: ExitLUT replaces softmax-based early-exit decisions with learned Boolean functions mapped directly into FPGA LUTs, reinvesting the saved exit-path resources into the datapath to achieve up to 4.08× throughput improvement without sacrificing accuracy.
